A taste of home
Nov 2024 • Couples
Even when you travel in another country sampling, all the great native foods, every now, and then you just feel like having something that reminds you of home.

This was the case of us last night when we spoke to our wink hotel local guide, saying that we were in the mood for something Italian.

We were directed to Al frescoes.

A quick grab ride.

We were greeted at the door by a lady who had the biggest smile, and we were directed to our seat.

The menu had a good range from salads to pasta to pizza,some Korean items, but what caught us was the good old Aussie pub favourites, the chicken, parmi, and the humble cheeseburger.

I was even asked how I would look how I would like the cheeseburger patties cooked - medium or well done, I went with medium rare.

While we were waiting for our food to be cooked, we took part in a jug (very aussie ) of Sangria.

The food arrived hot, my partners parmigiana was the thickest I've seen in a long time but it was perfectly cooked.

The cheeseburger was so tasty, the juices dripping onto the plate.

The tastes took us back home just for that evening.

We finished off with a huge apple crumble and ice cream for her and a chocolate pudding for me.

Did we overdo it?- Definitely. Did we enjoy it ? Yes. Would we go back again? - of course.

Now, it's not the cheapest meal we have done while here but was very nice.

If you are after candlelight and romance, then this is not the place for you, but it you are into pizza and pasta plus more, done nicely and quickly. This just might be the place.

Great Italian: Pasta and Pizza and the BEST BBQ Ribs in the city.
Jun 2016 • Couples
*** Located just behind the New World Hotel and across the street from the giant Starbucks.
I try to eat healthy and always look on a restaurant's menu to see if they have salad options. Al's has a few salad choices and they're all good. I always get the Al's Special salad and I add chicken, it's the best.
- Love their ice cold fresh coconuts.
But they have a lot more then just salads.
- Great Italian food, pasta and pizzas.
- The BEST ribs in the country, REALLY!
- Asian food options.
- Killer desserts, Yum!
- Very friendly staff and proactive on-site managers, very important.
My wife and I have lived in Vietnam for over 15 years and have watch Al Fresco's grow. We are thankful to have them in Vietnam and pleased to see them continue to do well. Now all the restaurants are undergoing a New-Look remodel which is a "Factory-Modern" theme that we really like, much like the new Starbucks decor.
